title: Nvidia raises its fiscal-2028 outlook above 75%
html:
Proposition

Nvidia raises its fiscal-2028 outlook above 75%

At its February 24, 2027 report Nvidia raises its outlook for fiscal-2028 revenue growth above 75%.

When
The decision on Feb 24, 2027
Known from
Nvidia fiscal Q4 2027 earnings release and call
Forecast30.0%
0%100%

How it’s set

Rationale

It raised the figure last quarter and guided fourth-quarter revenue to $130 billion against about $125 billion expected, with the Vera Rubin ramp its fastest. A second raise in a row is plausible but less likely than holding while the export and financing questions are open: three in ten.
